parameters: NW名前指定 黄色い熊
"I died not long after giving birth.
So the only Alice I remember is a little girl."
"Still an innocent little girl, unchanged from
those days. I know the warmth of her hand
very well. A single brush of it against my fur
would remind me that I'm a prided pet cat."
"You aren't the only one eager to meet Alice.
It's a shame. I really am sorry.
Dreams and lies are no different to me."
"——I'll be waiting for you past the door."
